Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic for chips, driven by big investment news from AMD and massive demand for Nvidia chips from SpaceX. This is good for your concentrated tech/chip book, but broader macro concerns from the IMF could add volatility.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -26.91% and a leveraged ETF that decays. SPAL is also a leveraged ETF down -12.64% with its stop very close. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions, especially SOXL and SPAL, and their stops. Also, watch for continued strength in the broader chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losers and be ready to act on their stops, while staying alert to chip sector momentum.
plays: SOXL: Given the "SELL" status and -26.91% loss on this leveraged ETF, seriously consider trimming or exiting. Re-evaluate your risk here.
SPAL: Your stop at 21.38 is very close to the current price of 21.97. Be prepared to respect this stop to limit further losses on this fast-moving leveraged ETF.
AMD: Scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup (entry 648.77-648.12, stop 647.15) backed by news of AMD's multi-billion dollar investment plans.
